lines.text: A stiff-necked man will suddenly be shattered, and by justice a king brings stability to the land.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a pit for his feet, and an evil man is caught by his own sin.
A ruler who listens to lies has wicked officials, but a king who judges the poor fairly has a throne established forever.
Where there is no vision the people cast off restraint, but blessed is he who keeps the covenant.
Whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high, and a man receives justice from the LORD.
